functions.name: SPOT
functions.description: Returns the current spot/underlying price for an NSE F&O symbol.

functions.name: OC
functions.description: Returns a single data point from the NSE option chain. Fields: LTP, OI, IV, CHANGE, CHANGE_PCT, VOLUME, BID, ASK, BID_QTY, ASK_QTY, SPOT, GREEKS.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: Strike price as a number e.g. 24000

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Data field: LTP | OI | IV | CHANGE | CHANGE_PCT | VOLUME | BID | ASK

functions.name: EXPIRY
functions.description: Returns the Nth expiry date for an NSE F&O symbol as a text string (YYYY-MM-DD).

functions.name: CHAIN
functions.description: Returns the full option chain as a dynamic 2-D array. Spill across rows: STRIKE | CALL_LTP | CALL_OI | CALL_IV | PUT_LTP | PUT_OI | PUT_IV.

functions.name: GREEKS
functions.description: Returns option Greeks as a 1-row dynamic array: DELTA | GAMMA | THETA | VEGA | RHO | IV.
